<|im_start|>system
You are a concise trip-planning assistant. Use tools for live facts.

# Tools

You have access to the following functions:

<tools>
<function>
<name>get_weather</name>
<description>Return a deterministic weather snapshot.</description>
<parameters>
<parameter>
<name>city</name>
<type>string</type>
<description>City to check.</description>
</parameter>
<parameter>
<name>day</name>
<type>string</type>
<description>Day label such as today or tomorrow.</description>
</parameter>
<required>["city", "day"]</required>
</parameters>
</function>
<function>
<name>estimate_travel</name>
<description>Estimate deterministic travel time for a route.</description>
<parameters>
<parameter>
<name>origin</name>
<type>string</type>
<description>Starting location.</description>
</parameter>
<parameter>
<name>destination</name>
<type>string</type>
<description>Destination location.</description>
</parameter>
<parameter>
<name>depart_window</name>
<type>string</type>
<description>Departure window label.</description>
</parameter>
<required>["origin", "destination", "depart_window"]</required>
</parameters>
</function>
<function>
<name>reserve_room</name>
<description>Reserve a meeting room with an explicit time range.</description>
<parameters>
<parameter>
<name>room</name>
<type>string</type>
<description>Room name.</description>
</parameter>
<parameter>
<name>start_time</name>
<type>string</type>
<description>Local start time.</description>
</parameter>
<parameter>
<name>end_time</name>
<type>['string', 'null']</type>
<description>Local end time.</description>
</parameter>
<required>["room", "start_time"]</required>
</parameters>
</function>
<function>
<name>lookup_incident</name>
<description>Look up an incident status.</description>
<parameters>
<parameter>
<name>incident_id</name>
<type>string</type>
<description>Incident id in INC-#### format.</description>
</parameter>
<required>["incident_id"]</required>
</parameters>
</function>
</tools>

If you choose to call a function ONLY reply in the following format with NO suffix:

<tool_call>
<function=example_function_name>
<parameter=example_parameter_1>
value_1
</parameter>
<parameter=example_parameter_2>
This is the value for the second parameter
that can span
multiple lines
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<IMPORTANT>
Reminder:
- Function calls MUST follow the specified format: an inner <function=...></function> block must be nested within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags
- Required parameters MUST be specified
- You may provide optional reasoning for your function call in natural language BEFORE the function call, but NOT after
- If there is no function call available, answer the question like normal with your current knowledge and do not tell the user about function calls
</IMPORTANT><|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
Pick a better city for an outdoor team lunch today: Seattle or Portland. Check both first.<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
<think>
I will check Seattle first, then compare it with Portland.
<tool_call>
<function=get_weather>
<parameter=city>
Seattle
</parameter>
<parameter=day>
today
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
<|im_end|><|im_start|>user
<tool_response>
{"city":"Seattle","day":"today","condition":"rain","high_c":12,"wind_kph":22}
</tool_response>
<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
<think>
Seattle looks wet, so I will check Portland before deciding.
<tool_call>
<function=get_weather>
<parameter=city>
Portland
</parameter>
<parameter=day>
today
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
<|im_end|><|im_start|>user
<tool_response>
{"city":"Portland","day":"today","condition":"cloudy","high_c":16,"wind_kph":11}
</tool_response>
<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
<think>
Choose Portland. It is cloudy rather than rainy, warmer, and less windy; keep Seattle as the indoor fallback.<|im_end|>
